name: Hospital of Antofagasta Data Processing Centre modernization
notes: DOMINION says it replaced and implemented new servers for the existing DPC at Antofagasta Hospital, modernizing processing/storage and migrating RAC with no service interruption; healthcare/enterprise data center rather than colocation/hyperscale.

name: Anacondaweb Temuco Datacenter
notes: Operator site says Anacondaweb has its own data centers in Santiago and Temuco with 24/7 support; DataCenterMap says the Temuco facility was invested in during 2018, has Tier III configuration, and offers cabinets, cloud servers, VPS, colocation, and hosting.

name: Optic Telecom Chile Arica
notes: Inflect lists a colocation data center at 268 7 de Junio, Arica, supporting cabinet/cage deployments and regional connectivity.

name: Telxius Cable Arica CLS
notes: Inflect lists the Arica cable landing station/data center at Los Artesanos with colocation, cabinets/cages, DIA, IP transit, Ethernet private line, and wavelength services; Telxius announced Arica as a Chile landing point for the Mistral subsea cable in 2021.

name: Solaer Atacama renewable-powered AI data center campus
notes: Solaer secured a long-term lease in Chile's Atacama region for studies and potential development/operation of a data center campus powered by 197 MW solar, 500 MWh batteries, and desalinated water infrastructure; capacity_mw left null because 197 MW is generation capacity, not confirmed IT load.

name: Grenergy Atacama Data AI training campus
notes: Grenergy announced GR Data and Atacama Data, an AI model-training project initially planned at 400 MW IT and scalable up to 1 GW, supported by OASIS hybrid solar/storage platforms. Month inferred from source published '2 months ago' as of 2026-08-11 where no exact day was exposed in search snippet.

name: Aysen sustainable data center initiative
notes: Local reporting says CORFO Aysen convened a public-private table to create conditions for installing a sustainable data center in the region, including an FNDR-backed prefeasibility study; Coyhaique municipality separately advocated for inclusion in the national data center plan. Early-stage regional initiative, no site/capacity/operator confirmed.

name: Opciones Concepcion Data Center
notes: Opciones states it has data centers in Puerto Montt, Concepcion, and Santiago; DataCenterMap/PeeringDB place the Concepcion facility at Ongolmo 1280 with hosting, housing, virtualization, and related IT services.

name: XHOST Concepcion data center / private infrastructure
notes: XHOST says it administers its own data center and owns its physical servers/infrastructure; company is based at Freire 247, Concepcion, Biobio. Public source does not disclose facility scale or exact technical capacity.

name: DNW.cl / DataNetworks Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists DataNetworks DNW.cl / DataNetworks Data Center in Los Angeles, Biobio, Chile as a colocation facility; no primary operator page found during this pass.

name: GTD Puerto Montt Data Center
notes: GTD markets a national colocation/data center network to Puerto Montt; Telsur page describes the Puerto Montt facility in Alto Bonito with 616 m2 gross area, 360 m2 white space, and phase-2 added capacity for 30 racks; Uptime Institute lists GTD Telsur's Puerto Montt project.

name: Opciones Puerto Montt Data Center
notes: Opciones states it has data centers in Puerto Montt, Concepcion, and Santiago; contact/PeeringDB/DataCenterMap evidence places the Puerto Montt facility at Seminario 372 and describes colocation/data center services.

name: Apoapsis Punta Arenas Datacenter
notes: Apoapsis advertises a professional datacenter in Punta Arenas, Magallanes, with colocation/housing, hosting, VPS, backup, redundant power, physical security, and free-cooling-oriented infrastructure; company describes it as the southernmost neutral datacenter.

name: CTR Punta Arenas data center project
notes: DCD reported CTR announced a US$20 million investment to build the first data center in Chile's Magallanes region, in Punta Arenas. Current operating status was not confirmed in public sources during this pass, so status is unknown.
